ANGIOGENESIS: Genes up-regulated during formation of blood vessels (angiogenesis).
APICAL_JUNCTION: Genes encoding components of apical junction complex.
APICAL_SURFACE: Genes encoding proteins over-represented on the apical surface of epithelial cells, e.g., important for cell polarity (apical area).
APOPTOSIS: Genes mediating programmed cell death (apoptosis) by activation of caspases.
BILE_ACID_METABOLISM: Genes involve in metabolism of bile acids and salts.
COAGULATION: Genes encoding components of blood coagulation system; also up-regulated in platelets.
COMPLEMENT: Genes encoding components of the complement system, which is part of the innate immune system.
E2F_TARGETS: Genes encoding cell cycle related targets of E2F transcription factors.
EPITHELIAL_MESENCHYMAL_TRANSITION: Genes defining epithelial-mesenchymal transition, as in wound healing, fibrosis and metastasis.
ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_EARLY: Genes defining early response to estrogen.
ESTROGEN_RESPONSE_LATE: Genes defining late response to estrogen.
FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM: Genes encoding proteins involved in metabolism of fatty acids.
G2M_CHECKPOINT: Genes involved in the G2/M checkpoint, as in progression through the cell division cycle.
GLYCOLYSIS: Genes encoding proteins involved in glycolysis and gluconeogenesis.
HEDGEHOG_SIGNALING: Genes up-regulated by activation of hedgehog signaling.
HEME_METABOLISM: Genes involved in metabolism of heme (a cofactor consisting of iron and porphyrin) and erythroblast differentiation.
HYPOXIA: Genes up-regulated in response to low oxygen levels (hypoxia).
IL2_STAT5_SIGNALING: Genes up-regulated by STAT5 in response to IL2 stimulation.
IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING: Genes up-regulated by IL6 [GeneID=3569] via STAT3 [GeneID=6774], e.g., during acute phase response.
INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE: Genes up-regulated in response to alpha interferon proteins.
INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE: Genes up-regulated in response to IFNG [GeneID=3458].
MITOTIC_SPINDLE: Genes important for mitotic spindle assembly.
MTORC1_SIGNALING: Genes up-regulated through activation of mTORC1 complex.
MYC_TARGETS_V1: A subgroup of genes regulated by MYC - version 1 (v1).
MYC_TARGETS_V2: A subgroup of genes regulated by MYC - version 2 (v2).
MYOGENESIS: Genes involved in development of skeletal muscle (myogenesis).
NOTCH_SIGNALING: Genes up-regulated by activation of Notch signaling.
OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION: Genes encoding proteins involved in oxidative phosphorylation.
P53_PATHWAY: Genes involved in p53 pathways and networks.
PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS: Genes specifically up-regulated in pancreatic beta cells.
PI3K_AKT_MTOR_SIGNALING: Genes up-regulated by activation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway.
PROTEIN_SECRETION: Genes involved in protein secretion pathway.
REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES_PATHWAY: Genes up-regulated by reactive oxigen species (ROS).
SPERMATOGENESIS: Genes up-regulated during production of male gametes (sperm), as in spermatogenesis.
TGF_BETA_SIGNALING: Genes up-regulated in response to TGFB1 [GeneID=7040].
TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB: Genes regulated by NF-kB in response to TNF [GeneID=7124].
UNFOLDED_PROTEIN_RESPONSE: Genes up-regulated during unfolded protein response, a cellular stress response related to the endoplasmic reticulum.
UV_RESPONSE_DN: Genes down-regulated in response to ultraviolet (UV) radiation.
UV_RESPONSE_UP: Genes up-regulated in response to ultraviolet (UV) radiation.
WNT_BETA_CATENIN_SIGNALING: Genes up-regulated by activation of WNT signaling through accumulation of beta catenin CTNNB1 [GeneID=1499].
XENOBIOTIC_METABOLISM: Genes encoding proteins involved in processing of drugs and other xenobiotics.
